independentMemory.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes

independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once.
